Notifications.Text: Echo: There it is. The root of the Lattice. Every CyberCorp process answers to that Origin.
Echo: Three lines leave the wall. West, through the gate facing you, to a Generator on your doorstep. North and south, through the gaps, to the Compute that pays for everything inside.
Echo: A Firewall plugs each gate, but the lines outside the wall are in the open. Cut them and the core starves. I chose you for this before you knew my name.
A Firewall in a gate stops your units walking through it, but not a Worm, which slips past occupied squares. Otherwise it has to be destroyed.
Echo: Their outer Generator is building, and one of those is a Worker. It's coming for your line.
Echo: More from the outer Generator. Its line runs back through the west gate.
Echo: That Generator again. Take a Connector between it and the gate and it stops.
Echo: Raiders leaving the north Compute, circling the wall toward your branches.
Echo: And from the south. Leave something at home.
Echo: The core is committing its reserve. You're costing them more than they planned for.
Echo: This is everything they have left. Break it and the door is open.
Echo: West line cut. Their outer Generator is dead weight now.
Echo: Another western link. The gate is next.
Echo: Keep pulling that line apart.
Echo: West line cut. Their outer Generator is dead weight now.

Echo: West line cut. Their outer Generator is dead weight now.
Echo: North line cut. That Compute no longer pays the core.
Echo: Another northern link gone.
Echo: The north line is in pieces.
Echo: North line cut. That Compute no longer pays the core.
Echo: Another northern link gone.
Echo: The north line is in pieces.
Echo: South line cut. The core just got poorer.
Echo: Another southern link gone.
Echo: The south line is in pieces.
Echo: South line cut. The core just got poorer.
Echo: Another southern link gone.
Echo: The south line is in pieces.
Echo: They've taken one of our Connectors. Everything beyond it is cut off from the Origin until you take it back.
Echo: Another link lost. Get a Worker onto it before the rest of the line goes hungry.
Echo: Our line is broken again. Retake that Connector.
